例句

  1. People wish they could live forever and never become older. However, if this wish came true, there would be too many people on the earth.
    人們希望能長生不老。可是如果這個願望成真，地球上的人就會太多了。
  2. I wish I could fly.
    我真希望我會飛。
  3. My brother wishes he could play the guitar.
    我弟弟真希望自己會彈吉他。
  4. I wish I could speak Japanese.
    我真希望我會說日文。
  5. We wish we could stay here longer.
    我們真希望可以在這裡多待一會兒。
  6. Ann wishes she could go to the concert with us.
    Ann 希望她可以跟我們一起去演唱會。
  7. If there were no trains, there would be more cars on the road.
    如果沒有火車，路上就會有更多車。
  8. If everyone came, there would be no seats left.
    如果每個人都來，就不會有空位了。
  9. If it never rained, there would be no rice.
    如果從來不下雨，就不會有稻米。
  10. If the park had more trees, there would be more birds.
    如果公園裡有更多樹，就會有更多鳥。
  11. If the shop opened on Sundays, there would be more customers.
    如果那家店星期天開，就會有更多客人。
  12. There are too many people on this train.
    這班火車上人太多了。
  13. I drank too much coffee today.
    我今天喝了太多咖啡。
  14. You have too many books on your desk.
    你的桌上書太多了。
  15. Don't put too much salt in the soup.
    湯裡不要放太多鹽。
  16. There were too many cars on the road, so we were late.
    路上車太多了，所以我們遲到了。
  17. I spent too much money in Tokyo.
    我在東京花了太多錢。
  18. There is too much sugar in this coffee.
    這杯咖啡裡糖太多了。
  19. I wish I could remember his name.
    我真希望我記得他的名字。
  20. If there were a station near here, there would be more shops.
    如果這附近有車站，就會有更多商店。
  21. If my wish came true, there would be no more homework.
    如果我的願望實現了，就不會再有功課了。
  22. Too many students were absent today.
    今天太多學生缺席了。
  23. People wish they could eat as much as they like without getting fat.
    人們希望自己可以想吃多少就吃多少，又不會變胖。
  24. If everyone had a car, there would be too many cars in the city.
    如果每個人都有一部車，城裡的車就會太多。
  25. I wish I could sleep a little longer every morning.
    我希望每天早上可以多睡一下。
  26. If all the students came at once, there would be too many people in the library.
    如果所有學生一起來，圖書館裡的人就會太多。
  27. My grandmother wishes she could see her grandchildren more often.
    我奶奶希望她可以更常見到她的孫子。
  28. If our dream came true, there would be a new park near our school.
    如果我們的夢想實現了，我們學校附近就會有一個新公園。
  29. Too many tourists come to this small town in summer.
    夏天有太多遊客來這個小鎮。
  30. If we left now, there would be enough time to eat lunch.
    如果我們現在走，就會有足夠的時間吃午餐。
